symptom: An offline navigation profile written by mxcli (`create or modify navigation PhoneOffline ... sync (...)`) builds and installs, but no page opens without a network: `Failed to fetch dynamically imported module .../dist/pages/M.Page.js`. mxcli check, exec and mx check all report 0 errors
cause: The profile stores ProgressiveWebAppSettings: null (navigation_profile_add.go leaves it null on purpose, and there was no MDL to set it). With null settings mxbuild writes "registerServiceWorker": false into deployment/web/index.js, for --target=deploy and package alike, so no service worker registers and nothing is cached
fix: `progressive web app [( Precaching: b, InstallPrompt: b )] | progressive web app off` on create navigation, written on the profile, described with the non-default keys, refused on native profiles; exec warns about an offline profile left without settings
insight: The setting is invisible to every check in the toolchain: the model is valid without it, only the BUILT app differs. The cheap probe is the build output, not the model -- grep "registerServiceWorker" in deployment/web/index.js after a build. A dev build (mxcli run --local) also has "enableServiceWorkerCaching": false and leaves dist/pages out of the worker's precache, so offline behaviour measured there understates a package build; measure on --target=package.
